$comment: Pinned inputs for the speculative-decoding requalification lane, so that
Why this file exists: the lane's arguments are not guessable months later, and
the wrong ones do not fail loudly -- a run with no tool parser installs no tool
grammar and the `constrained` gate would pass on a request that constrained
nothing. Pinning them means a future run reproduces the recorded one instead of
Any field can still be overridden on the command line; flags win over the recipe.
Paths may start with ~. Full provenance for each artifact: section 12.3 of
modelNote: The trunk to serve. 27 GB of real files, not a symlink farm.
speculativeModelNote: The subject head: what we are asking about. Must be the snapshot path, never a
realpath -- HF blobs have no extension and mx.load dispatches on it, so a
realpath sidecar makes rapid-mlx refuse to boot.
speculativeControlModelNote: The positive control: a known-good standalone head from the HF cache. Without it
a blocked run cannot be told apart from a broken sidecar, which is why the lane
parserNote: Passed explicitly because `rapid-mlx info` reports '(none)' for local model
directories. Leave these set: the `constrained` gate is meaningless without a
tool grammar, and it would pass rather than fail.
